behavior: When `Drawer.SwipeArea` unmounts during a swipe that opens the drawer, the swipe ends: the popup goes to its open place with no `data-swiping` and no `transition: none`, and the backdrop and `Drawer.Indent` have no progress of the swipe. In Base UI, the swipe area only lets an outside press close the drawer again. The popup then stays at the position of the gesture, and the indent stays at the progress of the gesture.
